title: A decision model can return the amount, or say it is not there.
friendlyTitle: A small decision model can return the number, or say it is missing.
summary: Liquid AI released d1.2 and d1.2-ultra, decision models that return a value, a box on a picture, or a probability, including from audio. They are on the Liquid API at $0.02 and $0.042 per million input tokens. If a requested figure is missing, Liquid says the model is meant to answer "not found" instead of guessing.
friendlySummary: Liquid AI released two decision models, d1.2 and d1.2-ultra. They return a value, a box on a picture, or a probability. They can also listen to audio. They are on Liquid's API at $0.02 and $0.042 per million input tokens. If the figure is not in the document, Liquid says the model should answer "not found" instead of guessing.
whyItMatters: Liquid says d1.2-ultra scores 75 on Artificial Analysis Decision Index v2.1, two points above the previous best decision model. That is Liquid's reading of the index. A probability is a sorting tool. Send the low-confidence cases to a person before the number goes into a bill, a form, or a reply.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Liquid says the larger model scores 75 on one public decision test, two points above the previous best. That is Liquid's reading of the test. A probability is a way to sort work. Send the unsure cases to a person before the number goes into a bill, a form, or a reply.
